title: Record the countdown ripple sum
body:
## Summary
- Decrementing `m` rewrites `1 + v_2(m)` bits, and the popcount changes by `1 - v_2(m)`.
- The countdown lengths therefore sum to `2N - popcount(N)`, and the trailing-zero counts sum to `N - popcount(N)`, for every `N` through `2^24`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
